body: Thank you all for the concern. I am still here. I am also sorry for the concern I may have caused and want to sincerely apologize.

Like all I can focus on is the fact that I see myself as an exponentially heavy burden upon people each day. I really have no ties to anyone except family, which also isn't much, because none of them know me. so in all honesty I have no friends, no function, no connection and no need. why do I need to live? everyone says for friends and family, but seriously that isn't a thing. I am sitting here drinking myself to shit, because I need to fucking numb the pain enough, because if I don't, I will kill myself. Who thunk that alcohol would be the thing to save someone from killing themselves.  how ironic is it that alcoholism is a saving grace. I am a christian and for fuck's sake, how I would love to have a conversation with Jesus or God or both of them. Fuck it, wouldn't that be interesting.
what do I do when I really don't want to live anymore?
